say:1:1622510001:1.text: Stop feeding people those tall tales! How many more folks do you want stumbling in there because you make it sound harmless?!
say:1:1622510001:1.source_cn: 豪尔赫，收起你那套骗人的鬼话！你还要用它害死多少人才够？！

say:2:1622510002:1.text: I believed you once. And the vines almost strangled the life out of me!
say:2:1622510002:1.source_cn: 我当初就是信了你，结果差点被勒死在藤蔓里！

say:4:1622510003:1.text: Saro, you're not exactly young anymore, and you're still as hot-headed as ever! Why would I lie about any of this?
say:4:1622510003:1.source_cn: 萨略，都一把年纪了，你还是那么急躁！我……我怎么可能骗...

choice_prompt:5:1622510003.text: Saro, you're not exactly young anymore, and you're still as hot-headed as ever! Why would I lie about any of this?
choice_prompt:5:1622510003.source_cn: 萨略，都一把年纪了，你还是那么急躁！我……我怎么可能骗人呢……

say:6:1622510004:1.text: Listen to me. Don't trust a word out of that fool's mouth. That giant tree is evil to the core!
say:6:1622510004:1.source_cn: 年轻人，你千万别相信豪尔赫说的话！禁语森林里那棵巨树，...

say:7:1622510005:1.text: Back then... Jorge was my best friend.
say:7:1622510005:1.source_cn: 我当初……我当初把豪尔赫当作最好的朋友。

say:8:1622510006:1.text: And because of his stories, I ignored every warning about the giant tree. Every single one.
say:8:1622510006:1.source_cn: 就是因为他说的那些鬼话，所以即便外面关于巨树的传闻说得...

say:9:1622510007:1.text: "Stories"? I told the truth. All of it.
say:9:1622510007:1.source_cn: 鬼话？我说的全都是真的。

say:10:1622510008:1.text: Don't start that again. I'm done being fooled by you!
say:10:1622510008:1.source_cn: 老滑头，你现在可骗不了我了！

say:11:1622510009:1.text: I went into the forest alone. I thought I'd find Jorge's stupid cat and bring it back as a surprise.
say:11:1622510009:1.source_cn: 再后来，我独自进了森林，想把豪尔赫那只蠢猫给找回来，给...

say:12:1622510010:1.text: And then, I heard Jorge calling for help. Clear as day. I ran toward the sound...
say:12:1622510010:1.source_cn: 结果呢？我在森林里里听见豪尔赫的声音在呼救，循着声音过去……

say:13:1622510011:1.text: Next thing I knew, the vines from that tree wrapped around me tight. So tight I could barely breathe! I thought that was the end of me!
say:13:1622510011:1.source_cn: 可下一秒，就被那棵邪恶巨树的藤蔓死死缠住！那力气大得吓...

say:15:1622510013:1.text: Oh shut it! If I hadn't learned a bit of fire magic in my youth and burned the thing, I'd be dead! The flames scorched its <style="highlight">dark brown bark</style> and its <style="highlight">twisted face</style>, and the pain made it loosen its grip long enough for me to escape.
say:15:1622510013:1.source_cn: 你闭嘴！要不是我年轻时学过点火焰魔法，拼命放出火烧它，...

say:16:1622510014:0.text: As it let go, I heard it muttering to itself. Something about <style="highlight">killing Perri</style>. I didn't stop to listen. I ran for my life!
say:16:1622510014:0.source_cn: 它松开我的时候，我亲耳听到它自言自语，那声音像是在炫耀...

say:17:1622510015:1.text: You must have lost your wits in there, Saro!
say:17:1622510015:1.source_cn: 你一定是吓糊涂了，萨略！

say:18:1622510016:1.text: The giant tree's bark is deep green, healthy-looking, gentle even! There is nothing evil about it!
say:18:1622510016:1.source_cn: 巨树先生的树皮是墨绿色的，看起来是那么健康、那么和善！

say:19:1622510017:1.text: And hurting Perri? Never. Perri was kind, and the two got along like old pals! Your story doesn't add up.
say:19:1622510017:1.source_cn: 而且，它怎么会伤害皮瑞先生呢，皮瑞先生那么好心，他们可...

say:20:1622510018:1.text: Oh come on! You can't even remember where your own cat went, yet you defend a monster that fools people for a living! You were tricked. Plain and simple!
say:20:1622510018:1.source_cn: 你个老顽固！你连自己的猫在哪儿都记不清楚，还在这里替树...

say:21:1622510019:1.text: You're the one mistaken. You never looked closely...
say:21:1622510019:1.source_cn: 是你弄错了……你根本没看清楚……

say:22:1622510020:1.text: Not closely? I almost died, Jorge. I saw more than enough. You're hopeless!
say:22:1622510020:1.source_cn: 我没看清楚？我差点把命都丢在里面看清楚！你真是无药可救！

say:24:1622510021:1.text: Gentlemen, please. Let's slow down for a moment.

choice_prompt:25:1622510021.text: Gentlemen, please. Let's slow down for a moment.

say:26:1622510022:1.text: He's the one who needs calming.

say:28:1622510026:1.text: The two old men keep going, neither able to convince the other.
say:28:1622510026:1.source_cn: 两位老人的争吵愈发激烈，谁也说服不了谁。
say:28:1622510026:1.male: The two old men keep going, neither able to convince the other.
say:28:1622510026:1.female: The two old men keep going, neither able to convince the other.

say:29:1622510027:1.text: Their long friendship now looks as fractured as their stories about the forest.
say:29:1622510027:1.source_cn: 他们曾经坚固的友情，如同他们对森林的认知一样，出现了一...
say:29:1622510027:1.male: Their long friendship now looks as fractured as their stories about the forest.
say:29:1622510027:1.female: Their long friendship now looks as fractured as their stories about the forest.

say:32:1622510024:1.text: Me. I saw everything with my own eyes.
say:32:1622510024:1.source_cn: 你该信我，我是亲眼所见。

say:33:1622510025:1.text: And I nearly lost my life. That counts for something!

choice:25:1:2.female: Alright, alright. Who's actually telling the truth here?
